description:
Validate that bit-channel analysis remains opt-in by benchmarking and testing the analysis-disabled path against the normal simulation and modem hot paths.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Benchmark coverage compares the standard hot path with analysis disabled against the same modem and simulation scenarios with bit-channel analysis support available.
- [ ] The analysis-disabled path performs no analysis-specific collector calls or analysis-buffer allocation during normal runs.
- [ ] Validation covers both correctness of bit-channel separation and non-interference with the shared fast path.
- [ ] The evidence is strong enough to reject designs that impose analysis overhead on normal simulations.

## Notes

This task is the guardrail that ensures analysis tooling does not compromise the modem framework's performance goals.
title: Benchmark zero-overhead disabled path for bit-channel analysis
